title: An AI Solved a Problem Nobody Asked It To That's the Future
description:
An AI agent solved a problem on its own. Nobody prompted it. Nobody told it what to do. It just did it.
That single moment says more about where AI is headed than any roadmap or keynote could. And how people react to it — delight or dismissal — tells you everything about how they'll fare in what's coming next.

We discussed:
◼ The moment an AI acted independently on a problem, unprompted — and why it felt like a glimpse of the future.
◼ Why AI capability is deeply polarizing — and how people split into "glass half full" and "glass half empty" camps when judging the same result.
◼ Why some people fixate on the one thing AI got wrong, while others focus on the far more impressive thing it got right.
◼ How the ratio is quietly shifting — more magical, capable moments, and fewer of the silly failures we used to expect.
◼ What it means that the "failure mode" of AI is disappearing faster than most people realize.

Inflection Point is a long-form conversation podcast featuring enterprise CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, heads of AI, founders, and board members on what it actually took to ship AI in production, how threat landscapes shift when AI enters the stack, and what the next chapter of Digital Intelligence looks like from the seat of the people building it. Hosted by Moudy Elbayadi, Ph.D., Chief AI & Innovation Officer at EVOTEK. No vendor pitch, no scripted questions — real conversations with the leaders who built it.
